text.en:
Void Invisibility effects last 2 seconds longer.

While Invisible:
 • <pve 400% /> <pvp [100%] /> Additional Base Melee Regeneration Rate.
 • Enemies within 15 metres will increase the bonus to a total of <pve 600% /> <pvp [200%] /> and <pve 800% /> <pvp [300%] />.

+100 Recovery
+100 Reload Speed
text.ko:
공허 은신의 지속 시간이 2초 증가합니다.

은신한 상태에서:
기본 근접 능력 재생 속도가 <pve 400% /> <pvp [100%] /> 증가합니다.
15미터 이내에 있는 적의 수 만큼 <pve 600% /> <pvp [200%] /> and <pve 800% /> <pvp [300%] />까지 증가합니다.

회복력과 재장전 속도로 100으로 증가시킵니다.
text.zh-chs:
虚空隐身效果持续时间增加 2 秒。

隐身时：
• <pve 400% /> <pvp [100%] /> 额外的基础近战充能速度。
• 15 米范围内的敌人将使额外充能速度增加至 <pve 600% /> <pvp [200%] /> 到 <pve 800% /> <pvp [300%] />。（和敌人数量相关）

+100 恢复
+100 填装速度

<void/>Void Invisibility lasts 2 seconds longer.

Entering <void/>Void Invisibility grants one stack of “Vanishing Shadow” for 7 seconds. Vanishing Shadow's timer does not decrease while <void/>Invisibile. Vanishing Shadow stacks up to 3 times. Additional stacks can only be gained after exiting <void/>Invisibility.

Each stack of Vanishing Shadow grants improved base Grenade, Melee, and Class ability regeneration rate.

Reaching Vanishing Shadow x3 or gaining <void/>Void Invisibility while at Vanishing Shadow x3 grants you a 15HP <void/>Void Overshield for 7 seconds (10 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistence).

// Soft Tested at 66% | 133% | 200% in the D2 Science Discord? 
// This was class ability, have not tested grenade/melee
